Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: === TEXT REPRESENTATION TORTURE TEST === Each step isolates one param type with no obvious text form. Watch what survives.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T0 | CONTROL | plain Set Field — must round-trip perfectly. If this breaks, nothing else matters.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T1 | Show Custom Dialog | 3 buttons + 2 input fields. Get(LastMessageChoice) depends on button ORDER. Does the text carry the buttons, their order, and CommitState?

Message.Calculation: "Račun " & I__INVOICES::BrojFakture & " će biti storniran. Unesite razlog."

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T2 | Perform Find [ Restore ] | 2 requests: one Include with 2 AND criteria, one Exclude (omit). Pure structured data — no text form exists. Do the criteria survive?

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T3 | Sort Records [ Restore ] | 2 sort keys, Ascending then Descending, Maintain=True. Does the sort order and its direction survive?

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T4 | Insert Text | DISABLED doc-block targeting $README — agentic-fm's own documented convention. 500+ chars with CR line breaks. Our own HR renderer truncates this at 117 chars and collapses CRs to " | ". Does theirs?

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: PARAMETER FORMAT: JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; [ "pologID" ; $pologID ; JSONString ] ; [ "invoiceIDs" ; $invoiceIDs ; JSONArray ] ; [ "racunOd" ; $racunOd ; JSONString ] ; [ "racunDo" ; $racunDo ; JSONString ] ) RETURNS: { status, attachedCount, errors, infos } NOTES: - Either invoiceIDs OR the racunOd/racunDo range must be supplied, never both. - Validation rejects invoices already attached to a different polog. - Writes ForeignKeyPologID via epSQLExecute; commit before any SELECT.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T5 | Go to Related Record | Restore + Table ref + NewWndStyles attrGroup with a numeric Styles bitmask. The bitmask is a magic number with no text form.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T6 | New Window | full NewWndStyles bitmask Styles=1076299266 plus geometry calcs. Same attrGroup problem, different step.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T7 | Set Variable with Repetition | repeatGroup — $buffer[3]. Does the repetition index survive?

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: T8 | Calc with embedded brackets, semicolons, quotes and inline comments — the parser torture case. Bracket-depth scanners break here.
